newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH 2006 BOND YIELD SEEN STARTING DOWN 10 BPS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH 2006 BOND YIELD SEEN STARTING DOWN 10 BPS.

text.p: Finnish bonds were seen opening firmer across the curve on Friday -- with the longest 2006 bond yield seen down 10 basis points -- taking strength from early gains in Bunds and U.S. Treasuries overnight, dealers said.
* Before the opening, the 2006 bond yield was quoted at 6.19 percent, down eight basis points from Wednesday's 6.27 percent close.
* The U.S. April NAPM index reported on Thursday showed a slight decline to 49.6 from 50.9 in March, lending support to bond markets.
* Markets will focus on U.S. jobs report due 1230/1530 GMT.
